_README: Class codes are NOT interpreted until a human confirms them. Run the audit, look at the class values and counts, check the Elliptic++ documentation / paper, then set confirmed=true. While confirmed=false the pipeline keeps class_raw only and leaves label empty.
_note: The mapping above is the commonly documented Elliptic/Elliptic++ coding (1=illicit, 2=licit, 3=unknown). It could not be verified from the schema report alone.
